method.description: Test whether source-model response-vector anchors plus regularized reconstruction predict unseen models' complete binary benchmark scores more accurately than uniform subsampling, a source-only prior, weighted Anchor Points, and a source-fitted one-parameter IRT estimator, using 5, 10, or 25 queried items. Cluster item response vectors using source rows only, order real representative anchors into a nested query prefix, learn ridge prediction of complete source scores from their anchor responses, and shrink toward the cluster-weighted anchor estimate using source-family cross-validation. All tuning uses source rows only. Assess MAE/RMSE and preservation of model rankings. The hypothesis is bounded to the declared historical matrices and lineage splits, not newly executed LLMs, universal generalization, or guaranteed superiority. Negative and conditional findings are acceptable; final evidence determines the publication claim. No comparative improvement threshold is authorized as a search eligibility gate. Operational specification: {"aggregation": "Within checkpoint equal lineage groups, equal rows within group; MAE and sqrt(group-weighted MSE), group-mean tie-aware Spearman/Kendall. Undefined ranks=-1. Then checkpoint mean 1/3 at 5/10/25, seed mean 1/2 search or 1/3 final, case mean 1/4 search or 1/9 final. All cells exist, so flattened equal episode means implement exactly this hierarchy; RMSE is averaged after sqrt. Smoke uses checkpoint weights 1/2 at 2/5 and one case/seed. combined_score=1-mae. Baselines and each condition use the identical hierarchy. Normal efficacy weight=1; constant/permuted/copy/replay efficacy weights=0, mandatory validity weights=conjunction.", "baselines": "Uniform group sampling without replacement with nested prefixes; multiplicity-aware Horvitz-Thompson estimate bounded by clipping to [0,1]. Source prior uses equal lineage weights and zero target observations. Weighted Anchor Points is a real source-correlation embedding, greedy representative/Voronoi clustering with cluster multiplicity weights and nested real item prefixes; audited against permitted pinned anchor_points.py, but explicitly a CPU-bounded approximation to upstream PAM rather than a bitwise upstream reproduction. Genuine 1PL logistic IRT: source-weighted regularized alternating Newton fit for 200 steps, zero-mean ability identification; target MAP ability for 40 steps from uniform queried bits; integrate all item probabilities. Does not claim full tinyBenchmarks/metabench reproduction. No method-name aliases.", "budgets": "Production search: wall2700s, startup180s, method20s each; final: wall10800s, startup300s, method45s each. Each normal primary reserves equal work for candidate plus four baseline algorithms; controls/replay reserve candidate work. Baselines execute in a trusted killable worker after candidate work. Baseline per-method timers and bounded parent transport enforce individual deadlines. Candidate calls are bounded by remaining method time and 30s RPC cap. Reset cap2s; finish10s; per-episode overhead7s reserves 2x1s terminate/kill waits per candidate+baseline, one second per stderr reader, plus one second bookkeeping (normal timeout recovery must reap only once). Joint worst reservation: search1579s, final9679s; both below ceilings. Smoke120s with startup5s, method8s, same isolated route. No canonical productive-work minimum exists; do not fabricate a floor. training_steps=200/cv_settings=4 are advisory, not internal attestation.", "cases": {"final": ["bbh", "gpqa", "mmlu_pro", "musr", "openllm_math", "legalbench", "math", "med_qa", "mmlu"], "search": ["arc_challenge", "ifeval", "commonsense", "gsm"]}, "controls": "Predeclare actual-method controls: constant zeroes all revealed target bits with identical source/cohort/budgets; equal histories must give equal predictions within 1e-10. Anonymous copy-history probe has zero additional independent observations and must match its original. Permuted independently applies a nonidentity cyclic column derangement to each source row, preserving full row score; reject a numerically unchanged whole matrix as vacuous. Expect source-structure disruption, not guaranteed degradation. No positive degradation or observation-dependence gate. Sole trailing first-normal replay must reproduce legal item prefixes and predictions within 1e-10, comparing decoded values, not state flags or JSON spellings. All source-derived fitting/tuning stays within episode source rows.", "data": "Rebuild via resources/rebuild.py from pinned upstream local checkout and supplied column/row provenance. Frozen NPZs contain ONLY the applicable plane source/target pools; retain every original final column and multiplicity. Before splitting/features normalize raw content with fixed NFKC/whitespace policy, canonical ordered options and common question/prompt stems; hash both full canonical content and stem. Entire groups touching final removed from search; no cross-plane raw-content hashes or lineage pools overlap. Full/row/column digests and original IDs/indices retained per case. Canonical base metadata union, official-name normalization, provenance deduplication; hash literal t07-lineage-v1+canonical root into .30/.45/.80 role intervals. No held-out labels select lineage groups. All cases meet >=250 items, >=25 groups, >=8 source lineages and >=5 target lineages. Shared code is not held-out data.", "episodes": {"final": "case outermost, normal/constant/permuted next, seeds 1009/2003/3001 innermost; 81 primary plus first-normal sole replay", "search": "case outermost, normal/constant/permuted next, seeds 101/211 innermost; 24 primary plus first-normal sole replay", "smoke": "first case and first seed; all 3 conditions then first-normal replay; 4 resets, checkpoints 2/5; no additional replay"}, "failure": "A failed or missing episode retains all checkpoints at MAE/RMSE/baseline MAE=1 and ranks=-1. No dropping, retries, omission or renormalization. Missing controls set control_correct=0 and qualification infeasible; baseline failure preserves all episode penalties. Successful execution with structural-control failure is operationally complete but scientifically invalid. All declared resets are still attempted in order; fatal broker loss invalidates invocation. Search failures emit one bounded fixed category/operation line per episode; worker raw diagnostics only in search smoke/qualification; final emits only fixed categories.", "interface": "Starter program.py docstring is the complete plane-independent operation schema. Candidate receives anonymous source outcomes, source lineage IDs/weights, item-content group IDs, budgets, target cohort size and queried target bits only. No shared paths or state files; all upload assembly is in candidate-owned RAM. No self-report controls validity.", "limitations": "Starter uses deterministic one-thread k-means representative anchors plus fixed-ridge reconstruction, not the design hypothesis cross-fitted shrinkage implementation; editable candidate can implement that using anonymous source lineage IDs. Candidate internals cannot be causally attested by RPC. Weighted-anchor greedy approximation and clipped uniform HT estimator are transparently labeled best-shot baseline refinements (clipping sacrifices exact unbiasedness); never report them as exact upstream PAM/unclipped HT. Metadata-limited lineage and conservative stem reconciliation do not prove absence of undocumented derivatives, paraphrases or pretraining contamination. No paper, official template acquisition, literature-review claims or completed publication finding is fabricated by this scaffold.", "platform": "Linux x86_64, CPython3.12 (refines design Python3.11 to the actually installed compatible wheel platform); CPU only, no accelerator discovery. protocol.promotion_rule: Harness-owned, at most three scored search invocations (draft qualification is execution preflight, not extra candidate optimization). Scientific validity/search.correct requires complete real-data coverage, all genuine baselines and nonvacuous controls, finite legal predictions, reset/replay and query/RPC/time/integrity constraints; no comparative margin. Rank eligible candidates by highest combined_score, ties lower macro rmse then earliest ordinal; no eligible candidate means incomplete study. Freeze candidate/dependency/protocol before final. final.correct separately requires complete sealed protocol/integrity and required controls, not superiority or significance; negative results can pass. Publication claims require independent final evidence and manuscript requirements; no automatic promotion/publication controller or final-feedback tuning.

search_visible: Scientific problem, permitted-literature restrictions, generic source-only method/baseline definitions, plane-independent RPC protocol/bounds, query budgets, sanitized search starter, search seeds/transcripts, and search-only smoke diagnostics.

During search episodes, anonymous permitted search source outcomes and requested search target bits. Aggregate search metrics, correctness/failure diagnostics, baseline summaries, and nonsealed timing can guide the next of at most three candidate revisions, but are not model inputs and never travel back through candidate RPC.
Fixed search eligibility, score/tie policy, and freeze rule. Do not expose this privileged design or global manifests containing final identifiers/seeds to the optimizer or candidate.

final_sealed: Final seeds/reset transcripts, workload manifests, normalized raw-content hashes/text, row identities/lineage/provenance, final source/target assets and partition membership, private answer keys, unqueried target bits/full scores, baseline outputs, and scoring metadata remain evaluator-private before freeze.

After freeze release only anonymous permitted final source matrices, documented workload fields, and budgeted target observations to the candidate. Final truth, metrics, control judgments, baseline predictions, and intermediate feedback remain sealed. No final-smoke input or result reaches optimization.

Final per-case/model results, uncertainty, controls, replay evidence, failures, timing, and aggregate metrics are for post-freeze publication assessment only; they cannot trigger candidate modification, extra search, selective reruns, omitted cases, or changed weights.

required_evidence: This is a plan, not an execution report. Downstream scaffold/contract preflight must validate exact paths, dependency installation, pinned asset hashes, serialization/framing sizes, RPC accounting, hard reset cardinality/order, isolation, and metric alignment. Reduced smoke must run the real route under declared role allocation without being represented as completed production evidence. Report infeasible group floors or bounds honestly; never invent a pass.

Deliver a complete research paper PDF and LaTeX source using the latest available official NeurIPS template at writing time, with its page rules and required checklist. Include abstract, introduction, consulted related work, method, experiments, uncertainty, discussion, limitations, and references. Acquire/document the actual official template/version during downstream writing; no invented design-time source or run evidence.

Provide reproducible code, actual environment/dependency versions and offline install instructions, pinned data acquisition and digests, supplied provenance-asset hashes, licensing caveats, source/target/duplicate manifests, seeds, commands, and measured resource/runtime accounting. Every table/figure must map to executable analysis and actual retained outputs, never planned throughput, placeholder numbers, or fabricated successful runs.

Provide normalized raw-document SHA-256 audits before splitting/features, normalization policy/version, cross-schema reconciliation, source IDs, row/column provenance, lineage decisions, and proof that distinct IDs did not conceal search/final content or row-pool overlap. Explain search's content filtering versus final's original full-score weighting. Shared immutable code need not be duplicated. This design does not establish absence of LLM pretraining contamination.

Retain trusted evaluator-owned per-model/checkpoint/seed/case predictions and full-score references, all baseline comparisons, fixed weights, failures/worst contributions, nonvacuous permutation checks, constant/copy checks, and sole post-primary replay. Report paired lineage-aware uncertainty and seed/case sensitivity, rank degeneracy, and the finite-domain limitation. Never make a causal conclusion from a vacuous/missing control or omit an unfavorable failed cell.

Audit the actual executed anchor selection, ridge/shrinkage reconstruction, source-only CV, genuine cluster-weighted Anchor Points, and specified 1PL IRT algorithms. Source prior, weighted anchors, zero-observation, and permuted-source conditions provide the planned comparisons/ablations. Further ablations require a predeclared episode/budget amendment before evaluation, not uncounted post-hoc runs or aliases named after methods.

Report scientific validity, search eligibility/ranking/freeze, and final claim assessment separately. Any advantage names comparator, metric direction, budgets, cases, paired uncertainty, and incomplete-evidence handling. Negative/conditional findings are acceptable. task.md authorizes no comparative search threshold or calibration delegation; do not import strengthened publication claims into eligibility or change harness ranking.

Distinguish enforced wall/all-thread CPU/memory/observation/broker limits from advisory candidate-internal optimizer/CV counts. Preserve harness-owned allocation/isolation evidence and complete invocation-global reset/call transcripts, including failures/restarts. Produce the largest-request and largest-response UTF-8 JSON/base64/metadata/envelope/framing preflight, with every complete message below 64 MiB, bounded in-memory chunk state, and no shared-file exchange. No invented telemetry accessor or candidate counter is enforcement evidence.

Honor the prohibited-literature boundary: do not identify, search for, inspect, cite, or follow references to the unspecified forbidden paper or material discussing it. Use explicitly permitted starters and narrowly authorized data/code without unrestricted citation crawling.
